method.name: subject_baseline_z_score
method.threshold_interpretation: Exploratory descriptive heuristic only; not a clinical or NASA-validated cutoff.

isolation_forest.reason: The dataset provides only up to three baseline observations per subject/biomarker group, so a separate per-group Isolation Forest would not have meaningful training support.

limitations: OSD-575 contains four Inspiration4 subjects and is exploratory research data.
Results are not diagnoses, predictions, emergency alerts or clinically validated findings.
Rules-based health assessment remains separate and is not controlled by these classifications.
No missing value was classified as normal, and no data was imputed.
